title: Find entities item effect outcome
description: Finds all entities matching the given condition in the given bounding box and runs the given outcome for each of them, originating from the given position. Adds a 'ref' entity, an 'index' number and a 'successCount' number to the context for the outcome.

origin.$comment: The position that the search will originate from.

bounds.$comment: The bounding box to search within. Format: [ x1, y1, z1, x2, y2, z2 ]

condition.$comment: The given outcome will be run for all entities that match this condition.

outcome.$comment: this outcome will run for each entity that matches the condition. A 'ref' entity (referencing the entity this outcome is run for), an 'index' number and a 'successCount' number will be added to the context for the outcome.

exclude.$comment: Entities listed in this array will be excluded from the search.
